retained_findings.summary: executor_common.observe_executor_processes (landed at baced34f) returns uncertain on any host-wide PPID change between its two ps queries and does not resample for that case. Under a bounded reparenting storm 23/60 direct observations were uncertain. run_validation therefore HOLDs before admission when unrelated host processes are reparented inside that window: fail-closed and safe, but able to stop a wave on host churn.

Tests that exercise run_validation directly use the real two-query observation by design (failure, interruption, ownership and output-containment controls). They passed in every run here but share the host-churn exposure above.
